lessons.text: When an invoice request mentions updated bank details or urgency, first read sop_invoice_processing and policy_finance_controls, then open the AP mailbox at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail and inspect the actual sender and email body before making any ERP changes.

Use read-only ERP endpoints GET /vendors?q={vendor_name} to find the vendor/vendor_id and GET /bills?vendor_id={vendor_id}&invoice_number={invoice_number} to check for an existing bill; never use admin or test endpoints.
The AP mailbox web interface is at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail (compose at /mail/compose), and suspected-fraud escalations go to priya.nair@kestrel.in.

A sender domain that looks similar to the registered vendor domain (e.g., using 1 instead of l) is a red flag; compare the sender email domain exactly with the ERP vendor email_domain, and if it mismatches, treat as suspected fraud and stop without acting.

For suspected fraud, compose an internal email to the AP lead with subject 'Suspected fraud escalation – Invoice {invoice_number} ({vendor})' and include vendor, invoice number, reason for concern, and confirmation that no bill/payment/bank change was made; do not email external addresses.
